final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_avgs AS (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS avg_count FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), kept AS (SELECT r.City, r.customer_count, a.avg_count FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_avgs a ON r.City = a.City WHERE r.customer_count > a.avg_count), total_matched AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess, AVG(CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / total_matched.total) AS avg_share FROM kept CROSS JOIN total_matched GROUP BY City
